scope: IMU publication and corrected quaternion contract source validation
changes: Available orientation, gyro and acceleration with unknown covariance use zero matrices; leading minus one means unavailable
Corrected orientation preserves valid w=0 at 180 degrees and rejects missing, nonfinite or nonunit quaternions
Raw and calibration quaternion normalization reject finite components whose norm overflows
initial_harness_failure: Initial full run had seven errors because test runtime files were mounted read-only and two opt-in integrations were skipped. A private tmpfs runtime corrected the harness; no application patch was made for that failure. The two isolated integrations passed in a separate opt-in followup.
limits: Source validation is not hardware deployment or motion validation
Zero covariance is unknown uncertainty, not perfect measurement
IMU mounting, sensor timing and real localization remain unvalidated
Historical recordings are unchanged; no automatic minus-one override
A recorder restart clears in-memory reference calibration; no forced calibration or new recording is authorized by a test result
